> Barnard Mohair is a South African second-generation family business making
> premium handcrafted mohair blankets, jackets and scarves from locally sourced
> Eastern Cape Angora goat fibre. Founded in Alicedale in 1967. Ships worldwide.

## What We Make

Barnard Mohair produces heirloom-quality textile products entirely from South
African mohair fibre. All products are crafted and finished by skilled women
from the local Alicedale community.

Product categories:
- Mohair Travel Blankets (R1,650–R2,200)
- Mohair Bed Blankets (R2,900–R3,300)
- Mohair Tunic Jackets / Peasant Coats (R2,695)
- Mohair Talisman Jackets (R2,495)
- Kid Mohair Scarves — 2-row (R495) and 6-row (R995)
- Dog Blankets (mohair pet throws)

## What Is Mohair

Mohair is the fibre obtained by shearing Angora goats. The Eastern Cape of
South Africa — particularly the Karoo — produces some of the world's finest
mohair due to the dry climate and pasture conditions. The fibre is known for
its silky lustre, warmth, durability and hypoallergenic properties.

Kid mohair: fibre from the first or second shearing of a young Angora goat.
It is the finest, softest grade — lighter and more delicate than adult mohair.

Brushed mohair: mechanically brushed to raise the fibre into a halo texture,
creating a voluminous, cloud-like appearance popular for outerwear.

## Sustainability & Ethics

- All mohair is locally sourced from Eastern Cape Angora goat farms
- Angora goats are shorn twice yearly — no animals are harmed
- Eco-sensitive production methods throughout
- No synthetic fibres used in core product range
- Community employment: products finished by women of the Alicedale area
- Biodegradable natural fibre — no microplastic shedding
- Heirloom philosophy: buy less, buy better, keep for generations

## Our Story

1967 — Jan Paul Barnard moves to Alicedale and starts the first mohair factory.
Early production used hand looms. Hand-spun and hand-dyed yarns created
mohair curtains, cushions and blankets for local and international markets.
Jan Paul's wife, Elsa (from Germany, trained fashion designer), designed the
original collections including carpets, jerseys, knitting yarns and blankets.

Machinery was later introduced to expand production possibilities.

Today — The second generation has taken over, continuing the tradition of
crafting quality heirloom mohair products. International delivery now available
via Aramex.

## Caring for Mohair

Hand wash in cool to lukewarm water with a mild wool detergent.
Gently press — do not wring. Lay flat to dry away from direct sunlight.
Do not tumble dry. Fold for storage, never hang knitted items.
Store in a cool, dry place in a breathable bag.
Shake or brush lightly when dry to restore pile and lustre.
Full care guide: https://barnardmohair.com/care-guide/
